question: Will Anthropic release a new Claude Fable model before October 12, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
Resolves YES if Anthropic officially releases a new Claude Fable model (newer than Fable 5.1) before October 12, 2026.

The model must be available to general users through an official channel (Claude apps, API, or cloud partners). Releases limited to selected partners or testers do not count. 

Any version number counts (5.2, 5.5, 6, etc.). Rumors, leaks, and hidden-routing reports do not count.
research:
# Research summary: Will Anthropic release a new Claude Fable model (newer than 5.1) before October 12, 2026?

As of October 8, nothing newer than Fable 5.1 has been officially released. "Fable 5.5" exists only as rumor and social-media chatter, and the window left is Thursday October 8 to Sunday October 11.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question gives no URL. The best primary sources are Anthropic's newsroom and the model pages in the Claude Platform docs.
- 2026-09-01: The Fable 5.1 docs page is marked "Latest" and its status is "Active (latest)". Model ID `claude-fable-5-1`, available on the Claude API, Bedrock, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry. [docs](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-1/overview)
- 2026-09-01: AWS announced Fable 5.1 on Bedrock. [AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/09/claude-fable-5-1-aws/)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-10-02: A check of Anthropic's model directory and Claude Code's supported-model list still showed Fable 5.1 as the current Fable. Neither listed Fable 5.5. [search summary of emergent.sh](https://emergent.sh/news/claude-fable-5-5-release-date)
- 2026-10-05: A report said Anthropic had given no Fable 5.5 release date, window or model ID. It mentioned that a specific date "next week" was circulating on social media but traced to no Anthropic document. Same source as above. I could not open the page directly, so this comes from the search summary only.
- Nothing settles the question yet. I found no official announcement of a newer Fable dated on or before October 8.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-08: Coverage of Haiku 5.5's launch. [Journal du Geek](https://www.journaldugeek.com/2026/10/08/la-version-gratuite-de-claude-devient-encore-plus-interessante-grace-au-nouveau-modele-dia-haiku-5-5/)
- 2026-10-07: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5. With it, the 5.5 family (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) is complete, and Fable is the only line without a 5.5 version. [Vals.ai](https://www.vals.ai/models/anthropic_claude-haiku-5-5), [Anthropic news](https://www.anthropic.com/news)
- About 2026-10-03 (I estimated this date from the X post ID): Andrew Curran posted that Anthropic would "save their strongest release until just before the IPO. We now know the name of that model: Fable 5.5." This is a rumor and does not count toward resolution. [X](https://x.com/AndrewCurran_/status/2106492521488814457)
- 2026-10-02: According to an OrcaRouter blog, the name "Fable 5.5" rests on one X post from this date claiming it beats "GPT-6 Astra". [OrcaRouter](https://www.orcarouter.ai/nl/blog/claude-fable-5-5-polymarket)
- 2026-09-28: Sonnet 5.5 released. [Anthropic news](https://www.anthropic.com/news)
- 2026-09-22: Opus 5.5 released, described as "first in the Claude 5.5 family" with "Fable 5.1-level performance" at lower cost. A Taiwanese report said Sonnet and Haiku 5.5 would follow "in the coming weeks" but said nothing about a Fable timeline. [TechNews](https://technews.tw/2026/09/23/anthropic-upgrades-claude-with-new-opus-5-5-model/), [ComputingForGeeks](https://computingforgeeks.com/claude-opus-5-5-released-features-benchmarks/)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-06-09: Fable 5 launched, with Mythos 5 limited to Project Glasswing. [TheNextWeb](https://thenextweb.com/news/anthropic-claude-fable-5-mythos-public-release-ipo)
- 2026-09-01: Fable 5.1 launched, about 12 weeks after Fable 5. [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/09/01/anthropic-claude-fable-5-1/)
- By October 11, only about 5.7 weeks will have passed since Fable 5.1, roughly half the only interval on record (n=1).
- The window is 4 days, ending on a Sunday. The two Fable launches and the recent 5.5 launches I could date all fell on weekdays (Mon Sept 22, Tue Sept 1, Tue June 9, Wed Oct 7). Haiku 5.5 shipped the day before the window opened.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-10-07: Polymarket's "Next Fable Model" event (resolves on any Fable model 5.2 or higher, and excludes 5.1). The biggest contract was about 91¢; the blog doesn't name it outright, but its trading volume suggests the October 31 contract. Volume: about $59.7k on October 31, under $6.1k on the October 12 contract and under $5.2k on October 14. I could not find the October 12 contract's price. [OrcaRouter](https://www.orcarouter.ai/nl/blog/claude-fable-5-5-polymarket)
- Manifold has a "will anthropic release claude fable" market dated around October 8, which reportedly noted no official successor announcement or model ID. I could not load it to get the probability. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/bumin/will-anthropic-release-claude-fable)
- I found no Kalshi market.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The window runs from October 8 (Thursday) to October 11 (Sunday). I found no scheduled Anthropic event, keynote or confirmed launch date in it.
- Things to watch: Anthropic newsroom posts, a new `claude-fable-*` model ID in the docs or on cloud partners (Bedrock, Azure, Vertex), and IPO-linked timing. Curran ties Fable 5.5 to the IPO, but I found no confirmed IPO date.
- A partner-only, early-access or leaked listing would not count.

Sources: [Claude docs Fable 5.1](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-1/overview), [AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/09/claude-fable-5-1-aws/), [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/09/01/anthropic-claude-fable-5-1/), [TheNextWeb](https://thenextweb.com/news/anthropic-claude-fable-5-mythos-public-release-ipo), [Anthropic news](https://www.anthropic.com/news), [Vals.ai](https://www.vals.ai/models/anthropic_claude-haiku-5-5), [Journal du Geek](https://www.journaldugeek.com/2026/10/08/la-version-gratuite-de-claude-devient-encore-plus-interessante-grace-au-nouveau-modele-dia-haiku-5-5/), [TechNews](https://technews.tw/2026/09/23/anthropic-upgrades-claude-with-new-opus-5-5-model/), [ComputingForGeeks](https://computingforgeeks.com/claude-opus-5-5-released-features-benchmarks/), [Andrew Curran X](https://x.com/AndrewCurran_/status/2106492521488814457), [OrcaRouter Polymarket](https://www.orcarouter.ai/nl/blog/claude-fable-5-5-polymarket), [emergent.sh](https://emergent.sh/news/claude-fable-5-5-release-date), [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/bumin/will-anthropic-release-claude-fable)
